turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner and I want to plan a nice Sunday together, help me choose.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me lay out all the options first. Don't interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a long brunch at that new place by the river, followed by a walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a cooking class in the afternoon where we'd make fresh pasta together.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could go to the art museum, which has a new exhibit opening this week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The cooking class sounds the most special, you get to do something together and eat the results. Brunch and a walk is relaxed and easy to enjoy. The museum is great if you both like art and want something calm.
